Our draft plan currently lists 40 simultaneous digital users, 10 print copies, and scanned PDF files. Before we proceed, I'd like to hear from each of you. Instructor, could you start by letting us know anything we should be aware of regarding the required reading packet? Then I'd like to hear from our copyright librarian, accessibility coordinator, and bookstore manager about any concerns or information relevant to finalizing this plan.
